description: Companies whose Bullrun composite risk score crossed into a different band (e.g. Elevated -> Stretched, or Acute -> Stretched) within the last N days, with prior and current score, the move in points, and the input driving the reading. Use for "what got riskier this week", "any risk deteriorations I should know about", or to monitor a watchlist (pass the tickers to get_company_risk afterwards). Band changes, not small score drift, so every row changed a word on the page. Read-only.

days.description: Look-back window in days for band changes.

direction.description: Keep only companies whose composite got worse, got better, or both.

minMarketCapUsd.description: Only companies with at least this market capitalisation in USD, e.g. 1e9 for $1B+. Without it the list is dominated by micro-caps, whose scores move most.

stableBasisOnly.description: true (default) = only real movements. false also includes band changes caused purely by a category starting or stopping scoring (coverage changes, flagged basisChanged).
